decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix and trigger its ability multiple times in a turn. It also utilizes spells like Treasure Cruise for card advantage, Lightning Axe for removal, and Fiery Impulse for additional damage. The deck is designed to be aggressive and tempo-oriented, aiming to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient spells. The inclusion of cards like Temporal Trespass and Proft's Eidetic Memory allow for additional resource manipulation and potential game-ending plays.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure on the opponent. With planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and versatile lands like Castle Locthwain, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a long game, ultimately grinding them out with efficient removal and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal damage to the opponent. The deck focuses on casting cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Opt to trigger the Phoenix's ability, while also utilizing cards like Picklock Prankster and Treasure Cruise for card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Profit's Eidetic Memory adds an extra dimension of graveyard recursion and card draw to keep the pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck features a mix of counter spells and removal to control the board and protect its threats.

The main idea of this Aggro - Weenie White deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small creatures, supported by cards that boost their strength and provide protection. Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar help grow the board presence, while Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts the opponent's plays. Cards like Portable Hole and Ossification offer removal options and control elements. The deck aims to quickly establish a strong presence on the battlefield and maintain pressure on the opponent, ultimately leading to a fast victory.

This aggressive Arclight Phoenix deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back the Phoenix from the graveyard. With cards like Artist's Talent and Consider to help fill the graveyard, as well as cheap removal like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise allows for card advantage, while cards like Picklock Prankster provide additional ways to trigger the Phoenix's graveyard ability. With a focus on speed and efficiency, this deck aims to close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Valgavoth, Terror Eater. The goal is to control the game with counterspells like Censor and Spell Pierce, while using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Unable to Scream to generate value. The deck also utilizes Prismari Command for card advantage and removal, with Shark Typhoon providing a flying threat. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting its powerful spells.

The main focus of this aggressive Red Deck Wins Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes a mix of direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike, alongside powerful creatures like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Emberheart Challenger. The aim is to apply pressure early and maintain board presence with versatile creatures like Sunspine Lynx and Manifold Mouse. The inclusion of utility lands like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear helps to further enhance the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By using powerful creatures like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Emberheart Challenger, along with burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, the deck aims to deal consistent damage to the opponent quickly. Cards like Monstrous Rage and Manifold Mouse provide additional support to boost the damage output of the creatures. The inclusion of lands like Rockface Village and Den of the Bugbear also helps to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The main idea behind this Aggro - Arclight Phoenix deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with spells, allowing you to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard multiple times. Utilizing card draw spells like Opt and Consider, alongside cheap removal like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse, you aim to control the board while also setting up for explosive turns where you can bring back multiple Arclight Phoenixes for massive damage. The deck also includes counterspells like Spell Pierce to protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the pace of the game through various removal spells and enchantments. By utilizing cards like Runed Halo, Perilous Snare, and Authority of the Consuls, the player aims to disrupt their opponent's strategy and protect their own life total. This control archetype also includes powerful planeswalkers like Elspeth, Storm Slayer for additional removal and card advantage. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through incremental advantages gained from its control elements.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through targeted discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with any threats they may play. The deck also leverages graveyard interactions with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to further control the game. With card advantage engines like Castle Locthwain and Liliana of the Veil, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually win the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Retraction Helix with Rona, Herald of Invasion to generate powerful interactions and advantages. By bouncing and replaying key creatures and artifacts, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent. Supporting cards like Stormchaser's Talent and This Town Ain't Big Enough provide additional utility and disruption, while cards like Mox Amber and Stock Up help to accelerate gameplay and maintain card advantage. Narset, Parter of Veils and Thundertrap Trainer offer additional card selection and filtering to ensure the combo pieces come together smoothly.

The deck focuses on using sacrifice synergies to overwhelm opponents with constant pressure and incremental advantage.
